## How to join LEDT

LEDT welcomes students at different stages of training:

| Level | How it works |
|---------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| **Undergraduate research** | UFAM undergraduate students, with or without a scholarship (PIBIC/PAIC). Calls are annual. |
| **Undergraduate thesis (TCC)** | Forest Engineering students interested in dendrology, taxonomy, ecology or spectroscopy. |
| **Master's and PhD** | Through the graduate programs in which LEDT faculty take part, such as [PPGBOT/INPA](https://www.gov.br/inpa/pt-br/posgrad/ppgbot). Admission follows each program's calls. |
| **Internships and visits** | Students and researchers from other institutions, by prior arrangement. |

: {.striped}

### Before getting in touch

1.  Learn about our work on the [Research](pesquisa.qmd) and [Publications](publicacoes.qmd) pages.
2.  Send us a message through the [Contact](contato.qmd) page describing your interests and stage of training, with a link to your CV (Lattes, ORCID or similar).
3.  For graduate studies, contact us **before** the program's call so we can discuss your project proposal.
